question.worked_solution:
Since $\frac{24{a}^{3}{b}^{2}}{25{c}^{3}}\cdot X=\frac{12a{b}^{3}}{15c},$ we have

$$
X=\frac{12a{b}^{3}}{15c}÷\frac{24{a}^{3}{b}^{2}}{25{c}^{3}}.
$$

To compute this quotient, we just need to multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{12a{b}^{3}}{15c}÷\frac{24{a}^{3}{b}^{2}}{25{c}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{12a{b}^{3}}{15c}\cdot \frac{25{c}^{3}}{24{a}^{3}{b}^{2}} & = \\ \frac{12\cdot a{b}^{2}\cdot b}{3\cdot 5c}\cdot \frac{5\cdot 5c\cdot {c}^{2}}{12\cdot 2{a}^{2}\cdot a{b}^{2}} & = \\ \frac{\cancel{12}\cdot \cancel{a{b}^{2}}\cdot b}{3\cdot \cancel{5c}}\cdot \frac{5\cdot \cancel{5c}\cdot {c}^{2}}{\cancel{12}\cdot 2{a}^{2}\cdot \cancel{a{b}^{2}}} & = \\ \frac{b}{3}\cdot \frac{5{c}^{2}}{2{a}^{2}} & = \\ \frac{5b{c}^{2}}{6{a}^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$
